meta_description: D White Electrical is a trusted local electrician in Nottingham. Emergency callouts, rewires, and installations. Call 07971 021395 for a fast quote.
hero_subhead: Electrical fault at home or work? We arrive fast, diagnose on the spot, and fix it right. No call-out charge.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full rewires, we handle every electrical job with speed and precision.

services.title: Emergency Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, tripped switches, dead sockets — we diagnose and fix electrical faults fast. Most jobs sorted same day, any time of day or night.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Old fuse box causing problems? We replace and upgrade to modern safety switches. Fully certified work with compliance paperwork included.

services.title: Full House Rewires
services.desc: Crumbling cables, outdated wiring, or pre-sale inspection failures? We rewire whole homes safely and efficiently, minimising disruption.

services.title: Kitchen & Bathroom Electrics
services.desc: Sockets, lighting, and extractor fans installed correctly to Building Regulations. Perfect for new kitchens or refreshed bathrooms.

services.title: EV Charger Installation
services.desc: Fast, safe installation of home charging points for electric vehicles. We handle all paperwork and testing to get you charging immediately.

services.title: Periodic Testing & Certification
services.desc: Safety inspection and certification of your home or workplace wiring. Protects your family and meets insurance and letting requirements.

about_pullquote: Fair price, honest advice, and the job done right the first time.
about_para_1: D White Electrical has served Nottingham homes and businesses for over 15 years. We started because too many customers were being overcharged and poorly advised by cowboys and big chains. From emergency faults to full rewires, we've built a reputation for arriving on time, explaining the problem clearly, and charging exactly what we quote.
about_para_2: We're NICEIC registered, insured, and certified to handle everything from simple socket replacement to complex commercial installations. Customers come back to us because we don't upsell unnecessary work, we respect your home, and we guarantee every job in writing.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Called at 11pm with a burning smell from the kitchen socket. Dave was here within the hour, found a dodgy connection behind the oven, and sorted it safely. Charged a fair price with no nonsense. That's proper service.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had the whole house rewired. Took three days, minimal mess, and the team explained everything they were doing. Very professional and left the place spotless. Would definitely recommend them.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Got a quote for a new consumer unit from another firm for £850. Dave quoted £650 and did exactly what he said. No hidden charges, brilliant communication, and the work was finished on time. Will use them again for sure.
reviews.author: Robert P.
